data.long_meaning: Michal means 'Who is like God?' or 'Daughter of God'. In the Bible, Michal is the daughter of Saul, the future wife of King David. She is known for her beauty and her love for David, but also for her deceit and her sorrow. The name Michal carries the meaning “Who is like God?” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Michal usually hope their child will grow to embody who is like god? and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: מיכל
in_hebrew.meaning: מי הוא אלוהים? או מי כמוהו?
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מיכל הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'מי הוא אלוהים?' או 'מי כמוהו?'. השם מורכב מ-'מי' שפירושו 'מי' ו-'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם מיכל מופיע בתנ'ך כבתו של שאול ורעייתו של דוד.

in_greek.name: Μιχάλ
in_greek.meaning: Τις είναι ο Θεός; ή Τίς ὅμοιος αὐτῷ;
in_greek.long_meaning: Μιχάλ είναι ἕνα ὄνομα ἑβραϊκό, τό ὁποῖο σημαίνει 'Τις είναι ο Θεός;' ἤ 'Τίς ὅμοιος αὐτῷ;'. Ἡ λέξις προέρχεται ἀπό τά ἑβραϊκά 'מיכל' (Mîkāl) καί εἶναι σύνθετη λέξις ἀπό τό 'מי' (mî) πού σημαίνει 'τίς' καί τό 'אל' (ʼēl) πού σημαίνει 'Θεός'.

in_latin.name: Michal
in_latin.meaning: Quis est Deus? Vel Cui similis est?
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Michal est nomen hebraicum, quod significat 'Quis est Deus?' vel 'Cui similis est?'. Nomen est compositum ex 'qui' quod significat 'quis' et 'El' quod significat 'Deus'. Nomen Michal invenitur in Biblia ut filia Saul et uxor David.

In the Bible, Michal is the name of the daughter of King Saul and the wife of King David. The name has been used in Christian tradition and symbolizes a deep connection with God, reflecting a sense of reverence and awe towards the divine.
